boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct library study environments across Loyola’s Lake Shore and Water Tower campuses, with documented study designations and access notes.

cards.title: Donovan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library, Level 1 · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Choose this silent-designated room when you want a defined reading-room setting. Bring the materials you need and keep conversation outside.
cards.short_summary: A historic Cudahy reading room designated for silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries identifies the Donovan Reading Room in Cudahy Library Level 1 as a silent study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cudahy Library; follow current library building access and hours.

cards.entity_name: Cudahy Library Level 2 Quiet Study Space
cards.title: Cudahy Library Level 2 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library, Level 2 · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a quiet-designated Cudahy study area. Set devices to silent and use headphones for any audio before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A Level 2 library area identified for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists Cudahy Level 2 as quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cudahy Library; materials movement may sometimes create noise in library storage areas.

cards.entity_name: Cudahy Library Level 3 Quiet Study Space
cards.title: Cudahy Library Level 3 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library, Level 3 · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Use this quiet-designated upper-floor area for independent reading or writing. Keep calls and collaborative work for a social-study area.
cards.short_summary: An upper-floor Cudahy area designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists Cudahy Level 3 as quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cudahy Library; follow current library building access and hours.

cards.title: Cudahy Stack Deck A
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Work among the stacks in this quiet-designated deck. Plan for a library setting where materials may be moved nearby from time to time.
cards.short_summary: A named Cudahy stack deck designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists Cudahy Stack Deck A as quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: The library notes that stack decks are materials-storage space and may sometimes have noise from moving materials.

cards.title: Cudahy Connector
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Meet a partner at the connector for a social-study setting. Keep your setup compact so the connecting route stays easy to use.
cards.short_summary: A Cudahy Library connector listed as social study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists the Cudahy Connector as social study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cudahy Library; follow current library building access and hours.

cards.title: Cudahy Library Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library, Lower Level · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Use the lower level for a social-study session with notes or a laptop. Reserve silent reading for the library’s designated silent spaces.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level Cudahy area listed for social study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists the Cudahy Lower Level as social study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cudahy Library; follow current library building access and hours.

cards.title: Cudahy Library Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Cudahy Library Mezzanine · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Bring a classmate or project materials to this social-study area. Use headphones and maintain the library’s appropriate noise level.
cards.short_summary: A Cudahy mezzanine identified as social study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists the Cudahy Mezzanine as social study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cudahy Library; follow current library building access and hours.

cards.title: Information Commons Level 1
cards.subtitle: Information Commons, Level 1 · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Use this social-study level for a collaborative work block. The Information Commons provides group-study space and high-speed internet.
cards.short_summary: A Level 1 Information Commons area listed for social study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists Information Commons Level 1 as social study space.
cards.access_notes: Information Commons is at 6501 N. Kenmore Ave.; follow current building hours and access rules.

cards.title: Information Commons Level 2
cards.subtitle: Information Commons, Level 2 · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Set up for collaborative coursework on this social-study level. Research help and the Digital Media Lab are also listed on Level 2.
cards.short_summary: A social-study level with nearby research and digital-media services.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists Information Commons Level 2 as social study space and locates research help and the Digital Media Lab there.
cards.access_notes: Information Commons is at 6501 N. Kenmore Ave.; follow current building hours and access rules.

cards.title: Information Commons Level 3
cards.subtitle: Information Commons, Level 3 · Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Take individual reading or drafting to this silent-designated level. Prepare downloads in advance if your work needs uninterrupted focus.
cards.short_summary: A Level 3 Information Commons area designated for silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Libraries lists Information Commons Level 3 as silent study space.
cards.access_notes: Information Commons is at 6501 N. Kenmore Ave.; follow current building hours and access rules.
